notes.title: Little update.
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32871681/037bb640ef2a5104b275468c5af217423ff8e186.png[/img]

The game now has a small survival mode with an interesting name. To start, use the new item in the game menu.

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32871681/13aab592bb55c3a30c8c9e62d8de80722ff82e29.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32871681/720f9b0b3bcbebf928476fb3e5eb8cd4cd608dca.png[/img][/url]

Key features of this mode:
- Timer. A small timer,located at upper part of the map. When it is finished you will be moved back to the menu with saving your highscore. By the way, you can see them in the community or directly in the game by pressing F1 (but it is advisable to do this when you have nothing to lose).

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32871681/fc9f19849af72f55d4b68686f9c65dbeddf680ca.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32871681/2d009798686e7b0a7f9569cc3a556bcbb6e887b3.png[/img][/url]

-- Score. From different corners of the map there will be crowding enemy waves coming out to you.

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32871681/8638b3926d2ac6443d305bd1ac92c8e3273eae20.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32871681/e904a937bec1f89b5bdc9ceb2939ad05f9034467.png[/img][/url]

While you are in a square area, your weapons receives a higher rate of fire. Otherwise, the rate of fire is reduced and time stops and kills stops counting in outside of square. Just stay in the box and everything will be fine. In case of lose, your points will also be published in a global leaderboard.

As the time decreases, enemies appear more abruptly and the area of ​​the square expands, thereby allowing you to better control the situation and overcome more powerful enemies.

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32871681/34c3d3759522d725d0f97cd329ab113b0c13409d.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32871681/55025fd546b27d47e22ab9999aca5d567965d79d.png[/img][/url]

Good luck !!!

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32871681/037bb640ef2a5104b275468c5af217423ff8e186.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32871681/5a9f0f205842113dd43a5e373e8888ba23b857e8.png[/img][/url]
